#2263
INTIZO DATE
QEPT 26,2015

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown

on Map No, 15-J in an area bound by:

The alley next north of and parallel to West Bryn Mawr Avenue; a line 28.74’ east of and parallel to North

Spaulding Avenue; West Bryn Mawr Avenue; and North Spaulding Avenue.

To those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3256 W. Bryn Mawr Ave., Chicago, IL 60659
